schema.name: Station
schema.description: Reference metadata for a BOM weather observation station identified by its WMO station number. Stations report half-hourly surface observations covering temperature, wind, pressure, rainfall, humidity, cloud, and visibility.

station_wmo.description: WMO station number assigned by the World Meteorological Organization, used as the stable identity for this station across all BOM products.

name.description: Human-readable station name as assigned by the Bureau of Meteorology, e.g. 'Sydney Airport' or 'Melbourne Airport'.

product_id.description: BOM product code identifying the observation product this station belongs to, e.g. 'IDN60901' for NSW capital city observations.

state.description: Australian state or territory the station is located in, as reported by BOM, e.g. 'New South Wales', 'Victoria'.

time_zone.description: Abbreviation of the local time zone for the station, e.g. 'EST' for Eastern Standard Time, 'CST' for Central Standard Time.

latitude.description: Geographic latitude of the station in decimal degrees (negative for Southern Hemisphere).

longitude.description: Geographic longitude of the station in decimal degrees.

schema.name: WeatherObservation
schema.description: Half-hourly surface weather observation from a BOM automatic weather station. Each record contains temperature, wind, pressure, humidity, rainfall, cloud, and visibility measurements as reported in the station's 72-hour observation product.

station_wmo.description: WMO station number identifying the reporting station.

station_name.description: Human-readable name of the reporting station.

observation_time_utc.description: Timestamp of the observation in UTC, derived from the BOM 'aifstime_utc' field in YYYYMMDDHHmmss format.

local_time.description: Local date and time string as provided by BOM in 'local_date_time_full' format (YYYYMMDDHHmmss).

air_temp.description: Air temperature measured at the station.

apparent_temp.description: Apparent (feels-like) temperature combining air temperature, humidity, and wind chill effects.

dewpt.description: Dew point temperature at the station.

delta_t.description: Wet bulb depression (difference between dry and wet bulb temperatures), used for bushfire danger calculations.

wind_dir.description: Compass direction the wind is blowing from, e.g. 'N', 'NNE', 'SSW', 'CALM'.

wind_spd_kmh.description: Sustained wind speed in kilometres per hour.

wind_spd_kt.description: Sustained wind speed in knots (nautical miles per hour).

gust_kmh.description: Maximum wind gust speed recorded in the observation period in kilometres per hour.

gust_kt.description: Maximum wind gust speed recorded in the observation period in knots.

press_qnh.description: QNH pressure — atmospheric pressure adjusted to mean sea level using the International Standard Atmosphere, used in aviation altimetry.

press_msl.description: Mean sea level pressure — station pressure reduced to sea level, used for synoptic weather analysis.

press_tend.description: Pressure tendency description indicating whether pressure is rising, falling, or steady over the past 3 hours. May be a numeric code or textual description.

rain_trace.description: Rainfall since 9am local time as reported by BOM. Value is a string that may be '0.0', a numeric amount in mm, or 'Trace' for very small amounts.

cloud.description: Textual cloud cover description, e.g. 'Partly cloudy', 'Clear', 'Overcast'.

cloud_oktas.description: Cloud cover in oktas (eighths of sky covered), ranging from 0 (clear) to 8 (overcast).

cloud_base_m.description: Height of the lowest cloud base above ground level.

cloud_type.description: Cloud type classification as reported by the station, e.g. 'Cu', 'Cb', 'St'. May be '-' when not reported.

vis_km.description: Horizontal visibility in kilometres. Reported as a string as BOM may include qualifiers.

weather.description: Present weather description, e.g. 'Rain', 'Fog', 'Thunderstorm'. May be '-' when no significant weather.

sea_state.description: Sea state description for coastal stations, e.g. 'Smooth', 'Slight', 'Moderate'.

swell_dir_worded.description: Dominant swell direction as a compass bearing word for coastal stations.

swell_height.description: Dominant swell height for coastal stations.

swell_period.description: Dominant swell period for coastal stations.

latitude.description: Latitude of the station at observation time.

longitude.description: Longitude of the station at observation time.

state.description: Normalized routing field 'state' added for MQTT/AMQP subscriber filtering.

schema.name: WarningBulletin
schema.description: Current weather warning bulletin item from a Bureau of Meteorology RSS warnings feed. Each item points to the published warning product page and carries the update timestamp and headline text from the feed.

warning_id.description: Stable BOM warning product identifier derived from the linked product page path, for example 'IDN21037'.

warning_url.description: Absolute BOM URL of the warning product page linked from the RSS item.

feed_url.description: Absolute BOM RSS feed URL that published this warning item.

feed_title.description: Title of the RSS feed channel publishing this warning bulletin.

title.description: Normalized warning headline text from the RSS item title with line breaks collapsed to spaces.

published_at.description: UTC timestamp when the RSS item was created or updated, taken from the item's pubDate field.

issued_local_time_text.description: Local issuance time prefix embedded in the RSS headline, for example '08/16:29 EST', when present.

warning_type.description: Warning headline extracted from the RSS title before the trailing affected-area clause, for example 'Severe Weather Warning'.

affected_area_text.description: Affected area clause extracted from the RSS title after the word 'for', for example 'parts of Snowy Mountains Forecast District.'.

severity.description: Normalized routing field 'severity' added for MQTT/AMQP subscriber filtering.

state.description: Normalized routing field 'state' added for MQTT/AMQP subscriber filtering.
